notes.title: Silver Daze is OUT!!!
notes.content: [p]It's finally here! I hope you guys are eager to play Silver Daze![/p][p][/p][p]The reception I've gotten for this game has been astounding and I couldn't be happier. I hope everyone here enjoys Silver Daze even a fraction of how much I enjoyed making it, and maybe you'll find some meaning in its themes.[/p][p][/p][p]If you liked this game, we would really love a review to tell us what we did right! Thanks a bunch from the bottom of my heart![/p][p]-Sawyer Friend[/p]

notes.title: SILVER DAZE DEMO - SPECIAL NEXT FEST UPDATE
notes.content: [p]IT'S FINALLY TIME! Welcome to Next Fest! I hope you guys get to find some awesome new games! [/p][p]The Silver Daze Demo is getting an exclusive new update to celebrate![/p][p][/p][p]This update features exclusive content that isn't present in the full game, which you'll be able to transfer up when Silver Daze releases![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/68d96456d29edf624a508a7de4da83411c6e2700.png"][/img][/p][p]Once you beat the main story of the demo, simply exit Geo's Room and a short scene will play, prompting you where to go next.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/ea75788468f3dd7710a3ceb9a2e723edbc8ca5c0.png"][/img][/p][p]You'll be able to explore a new type of dungeon called a ReCollection, where you'll be given challenges to wager points![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/535359de578ed5c167a632759432ad5fdb7fcbaa.png"][/img][/p][p]Explore this dungeon to hunt down enemies and rack up points, completing challenges to get big multipliers![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/3d101512edab362c8324101a68d7c3a877268898.png"][/img][/p][p]Then once you reach the end, you can spend those points to obtain rare cards, including the Demo Exclusive "GoddessTear"![/p][p][/p][p]I hope you guys enjoy this new demo content, and look forward to playing Silver Daze when it releases! See you soon![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: May Report
notes.content:
Yo!
So, it looks like I managed to totally forget about the April report! I'm sorry about that, as you can expect we have been super busy from the aftermath of the Kickstarter!

But hey, let's get you guys posted on that!

First up, effectively every Kickstarter card is finished! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/1daf3cafceb7765460ae8c4f7b25b4dec93fd46c.png[/img]
There are one or two cards remaining that I still need survey responses on, but past that everyone's finished and implemented in the game!

Along with that, there are a lot of monsters I'm still waiting on, but I've finished every one that's come in so far! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/53daf4e164c74aa84bf18af26d8f540badead8ce.png[/img]
That said, please finish your backer survey if you haven't already!

We've also been doing lots of work on the soundtrack, as well as creating more content to add to the game. We are well past the halfway point on completion now, so please look forward to more information as we move along!

Now here's some mostly unrelated news!
This month is Next Fest, and Silver Daze will be participating! Of course, if you're here, you already know about Silver Daze and have probably played the demo, but this is one of our biggest pushes to get more eyeballs in the game! To celebrate, we've created a brand new scenario for the demo, which includes its very own exclusive card!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/68d96456d29edf624a508a7de4da83411c6e2700.png[/img]

You guys should definitely play the new content and experience the exclusive ReCollection for yourself!

Well, things are looking good! Look forward to more when Next Fest drops!

notes.title: MARCH REPORT
notes.content:
Let's get started with this month's report!

Right out the gate, I'm excited to introduce the brand new main protagonist of Silver Daze: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/e47558b73221341622beef116ba78923f4265986.jpg[/img]

That's right! The game is now about Yoyo the snail! Aren't you guys happy and excited?

Okay okay, there's my April Fool's joke for the year. Let's actually discuss this month now.


So, first off, I want to thank everyone so far who has backed the[url=kickstarter.com/projects/gem-games-ltd/silver-daze-a-coming-of-age-jrpg] Silver Daze Kickstarter[/url]! We're at 78% completion at time of writing, so we are doing pretty well but we still need a lot of help to get that last push! If you haven't already, please back it! This is the last time I'm gonna ask, because the Kickstarter ends on the 13th of this month!

Now, I have to be honest, this was a very difficult month for my personal life.
Diehard Sawyer fans (I'm sure they exist) know that I work at a Jersey Mike's for my day job, and March is the month that we host our ever-important Day of Giving, the busiest day of the year. A lot of time this month was spent preparing for that, as well as handling an unexpected medical situation which I'm currently working on recovering from financially. There's also, of course, that Kickstarter eating up a bunch of my attention and emotional energy.

Now, that's a lot of personal stuff, so I am sorry if that's too much information for you, but this is basically context to establish that this month has been slower on the development side as I deal with all kinds of nonsense in my personal life. This doesn't mean that we got *nothing* done, but it'll be harder to show off everything we've accomplished this time.

First, I think I'll show you guys the White Zone so far!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/226e4cfbae4cb971ef5cde3c1f6607cce2b0d7d6.png[/img]
This Zone is special compared to other Zones, and it's completely optional! You'll find all kinds of challenging foes here, as well as some other optional content. I can't post it here yet, but the music in this Zone is some of my favourite in the entire game as well!

We've of course been working on expanding and refining the game systems. There is a feature that I've completed that I think you guys will like a lot, but I won't announce it until I thoroughly test its impact on the full game. If I like it, you'll hear about it sooner than later!

Alongside that mystery feature, we've added a description of each character's Special to the status screen! It's a pretty small note, but one that I think was in relatively high demand.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/c7ea3110ce981951c206dc295526b01697f5687a.png[/img]


Last up, we've introduced a brand new collectible: the Starstud!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/05d46cd1e7cad7f4c5c558f68da50871bf5a3580.png[/img]

These little things appear throughout the world in the later portions of the game. They're a little like chests in that picking one up will give you an item; however, unlike chests, this item isn't fixed to the location of the Starstud you've collected, but instead the number of Starstuds you've found up to this point! Find every StarStud to get an awesome prize!

We got more done than just this, but most of it is under-the-hood nonsense like tweaking formulas to improve the game experience. I hope you guys don't mind a quieter month, but I'll see you again after that Kickstarter succeeds!

notes.title: FEBRUARY END OF MONTH REPORT
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Before I forget, only TWO WEEKS remain before the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gem-games-ltd/silver-daze-a-coming-of-age-jrpg]Silver Daze Kickstarter[/url] begins on March 14th! Please follow it, we have some great exclusive rewards!

Okay! Let's get into the nitty gritty!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/4572ac8e46b939677a6e0c4f7ef08b0bfc8715fd.png[/img]
Once you finish Silver Daze, get ready for even more fun in the Silver Daze Randomizer!

This new feature will shuffle the items in the game across the world, allowing you to explore and test your knowledge in a whole new way! Seek out keys and party members to open up paths to your goal!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/03945e0abd9b59e87a9a18b16c33899e1b147317.png[/img]

We spent a lot of time setting this feature up and I've been really enjoying playing it! I think you will too.

The randomizer was our big announcement that isn't all we did this month! We spent a big chunk of time on the game's White Zone, but unfortunately I can't show off too many screenshots because it's a spoiler!

We're getting some great progress in, and once the Kickstarter completes we'll be on track for the big home stretch! I can't wait to see you there!

Overall, I'm really proud of the work I've gotten done this month, but it's a real shame I can't show it off here. This last month I've created some of the coolest cutscenes, music, and battles yet for this game. In my humble opinion, I've even outclassed Axial entirely in the hype department, but it won't be hype if I show you now! But stay tuned, one of those Kickstarter rewards might let you get a sneak peek early!

notes.title: January Report
notes.content:
This was a tough month!

We started pretty strong, with the announcement that the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gem-games-ltd/silver-daze-a-coming-of-age-jrpg]Silver Daze Kickstarter[/url] will be launching on March 14th!
You guys should really give it a follow, so you can get in on the exclusive rewards as early as possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/071393c6107d04938b8776e7bb6140d5c8c032ce.png[/img]

Furthermore, Silver Daze will be featured in the RPG Maker Fest on Steam! If you play the demo during this time, you'll get an exclusive new card!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/98460579e06e3f80978d11b345bea38a738d4c89.png[/img]

As for development on the game though...
Well, with all the new features we've been adding to Silver Daze over the past few months, something was bound to break!
So, the bad news is that the bulk of this month was spent testing and fixing things. There were a good number of bugs, a lot of balance issues, and little miscellaneous tweaks that I felt needed to be made. As a result, this month passed me by in a blink, and it feels like I got very little accomplished!

However, the good news is that we have actually gotten a lot of work done! It's just been quieter, without all the huge bombastic setpieces getting added in like in previous months. The first month of 2025 is instead dedicated towards stability, making Silver Daze a strong game that can live up to the expectations that these setpieces set up! Every bug that we catch now, every balance error I smooth out, and every line of dialogue I give a second pass is one more part of the game that will be better for you guys when you get to play it! I value putting my best foot forward, and if that means the game takes a little longer to be complete, it'll be worth it to ensure that you guys are given the best game we can make.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/36240619708da2d46df16dbaf24fe8a661d6ce61.png[/img]

There is some new content that we created this month, but unfortunately most of it is getting into heavy spoiler territory! I don't want to show off some of the later dungeons or boss fights, because you guys deserve to see those for yourself without having the surprise ruined for you in some blog post!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/a2cd10bb20fd5e8eb4edaab560309d213d128932.png[/img]

There is one super secret feature that I am especially eager for you guys to see though, and I might even tell you all about it on a later date... but for now, we're gonna have to keep it hush hush!

notes.title: END OF DECEMBER REPORT/2024 REPORT
notes.content:
It becomes increasingly difficult to do these reports as I finish more and more content, because the further we get into the game the more the new content becomes very spoiler heavy.

With that said, I'll do my best!

For starters, we've still got a long way to go before we hit our goal on the Kickstarter! [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gem-games-ltd/silver-daze-a-coming-of-age-jrpg]Please give it a follow[/url] if you're interested in Silver Daze.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/11f22bb77b660e2929a959776ab4911d66e23ded.png[/img]

The current section of the game includes a lot of ReCollections, so that's where the bulk of work has gone. In addition to making more of them, we've also added new features such as an improved radar to help you detect enemies hiding in these dungeons!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/aa0259bf211d3ed8a192abc7b9b010096a6c622d.png[/img]

We've also added in special encounters that can be found in the later portions of the game. This fellow here is called MajorTom, and if you find him you can attack him to get rare and exclusive cards... but he's gonna disappear fast!

We've also made some story tweaks in response to tester feedback from the previous build, and generally continued the pace to keep the game moving.



BUT! How about this whole year?

We began developing Silver Daze in August of 2023, just a month after [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1956680/Axial_Disc_2/]Axial Disc 2[/url] released. That means that as of writing this, the game has been in development for 17 months, a little under a year and a half!

Honestly, I'm really proud of how far we've come in this time! During the last year, we've completed five whole Zones, which is a massive chunk of the game's content! While it is difficult to make any promises while the Kickstarter growth is looking so slow, it's starting to look like a 2025 release is possible!

From the Silver Daze Team, we hope you guys have a happy New Year! Please look forward to Silver Daze as it continues its development!

notes.title: END OF NOVEMBER REPORT
notes.content:
Heyo! Sorry, I know this is a couple days late!

Before I go any further though, I'd like to ask that you [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gem-games-ltd/silver-daze-a-coming-of-age-jrpg]check out our Kickstarter page[/url] and give it a follow! We've got a lot of cool rewards in store, and following it will allow you to get in early and claim them yourselves! This will be your only opportunity to pick up these rewards!

Now, onto the update!

I went into November with a challenge for myself: try to start and complete Yellow Zone all in one month!

Truth be told, this didn't happen. However, we got REAL close, making all the content up through the final boss of the zone. As of today I've completed that boss, and I'll begin testing for the zone to make sure it's up to my standards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/2c15b1e9340dab4b700e69ceca8a3c2f38263294.png[/img]

Here's the good news! Yellow Zone looks [i]stunning[/i]! This whole zone has this real somber vibe to it which I think really fits its place in the story. I really enjoyed creating the giant yellow moon background, as well as trying to create a balance between the contrasting purple colour without overpowering the titular yellowness of this location.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/551193f2bc74ef5840bbb2c0c8ab72070b21ccc8.png[/img]

We also got to create a few new enemy species for this zone, and I think this firefly looks pretty neat!

A large chunk of the zone was dedicated to creating maps, content, and cutscenes, a lot of which I don't want to show off yet. This was a big challenge in general because of the pace that I was pushing myself to complete things, and a concern I have is that my speed may have lead to a sloppier product.

I have no intention of releasing a game with flaws I can easily fix, so now that Yellow Zone is more or less complete, I'll be doing a thorough pass through it and ensuring that it retains the quality that the rest of the game has shown. I think this could cause Yellow Zone to "technically" reach completion early next year, but I think we're on a really good pace here!

Alongside the content for Yellow Zone, a lot of time was spent playtesting, and most importantly, creating animations for every card!
At the moment we have 270 cards planned, and of these, 235 have complete animations! The last few animations will be the most time consuming as they are "special" animations for very rare cards, but it is likely we'll see the animations completed entirely within the next few months!

Silver Daze still has a ways to go before completion, but we are making steady progress! I look forward to showing you guys the next update!

notes.title: Silver Daze Kickstarter Approaches!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As mentioned in our previous post, Silver Daze will be running a Kickstarter to help fund the game to completion! These funds will ensure that we can finish the game, so your support is deeply appreciated!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/login?then=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kickstarter.com%2Fprojects%2Fgem-games-ltd%2Fsilver-daze-a-coming-of-age-jrpg%2Fwatch][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/d3582813fa23623ddfe6eec8f206e5f8e94666d6.gif[/img][/url]

This Kickstarter has a lot of cool rewards and stretch goals you can get!

Don't worry though, you don't need to break the bank to support Silver Daze! We have a huge selection of unlimited rewards that anyone can pledge!

[h2]Unlimited Rewards![/h2]

For just [b]$2[/b], you'll get your name in the credits! We really appreciate your support!

Once you pledge [b]$5[/b] however, the real rewards start kicking in! At $5, you'll be given access to a code to unlock the exclusive Kickstart card!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/24430db61f28ab3fa0ec189fca1cf19903f94397.png[/img]

Next, at [b]$10[/b], you'll be given a copy of Silver Daze when it comes out! This is going to be a substantial discount from its retail price, so make sure you pick it up now!

If you pledge [b]$15[/b], you'll also be given a copy of the game's soundtrack! We've already composed over 60 tracks for this game, and there's more to come as we continue development!

At[b] $25[/b], you'll be given everything below as well as a code for a Foil variant of the Kickstart card!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/c24b319de73ba5046ed2341556e517fa8688964c.png[/img]
This card is already pretty strong, but now it's an ultra rare version that gives you an EP discount no matter who it's equipped to! Talk about starting the game with an edge!

Alright fellas, this is the big one that I think you'll all want to get in on...

At [b]$40[/b], you'll be given everything below, as well as a copy of the Shining Backer Edition! The Shining Backer Edition will have your Steam Id directly etched into the game's code to ensure that this is the one and only way for you to obtain this version of the game! You'll become a permanent part of Silver Daze history!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/980357e69125d777debe11a7717cf4435f5475a0.png[/img]
The Shining Backer Edition features a prestigious windowskin and title screen based on the game's rare Foil cards, but that's not the best part!
Players with the Shining Backer Edition will have a permanent increased chance of finding a Foil Enemy! Foils are extremely rare in Silver Daze, and this is the only way to increase your chances beyond the base odds!
The only way to get in on the Shining Backer Edition is to support the game on Kickstarter, so don't miss out on this opportunity!

Finally, at [b]$200[/b], you'll be given monthly access to Silver Daze in its current state, no matter where it is in development! You could play Silver Daze as soon as you back the Kickstarter and see everything sooner than the rest of the world!

Along with this, all reward tiers exceeding $40 will be given physical trading cards featuring Pinn, Kani, Geo, and Wink!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/41375af61b79abe4db7e16cdaea39c07ab4d2452.png[/img]

But don't worry! If you want to be REALLY exclusive, we have a number of rewards only available to the first few backers! You'll want to snatch them quickly, because they'll be sold out fast!


[h2]Limited Rewards![/h2]

The first few people to back $70 will receive the Card Crafter reward! This reward will let you create one card of your own (and you'll get a code to obtain a free copy of it!)
There's limited quantity of those, so after the first few backers it'll become a $90 reward! Get in early to claim your very own card!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/af8dde06a2a6432733c5d95970b2ac4f1a4e440d.png[/img]

If you want to make an even bigger impact on the full game, the first few backers who pledge $100 will receive the Monster Maker reward, and they get to design their very own monster that Pinn and friends will battle in the final game! This is just like the Card Crafter reward; after the first few backers pledge this reward, the cost will increase to $130. If you want to make a full blown enemy that will appear in the game, make sure you're one of the first!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/d0f4951f1e87d0e02dd47369c76bc81d45302fb5.png[/img]

Finally, the first two backers to pledge $500 will be given access to the Elite Package!
Not only do you get a guaranteed slot for the Card Crafter and Monster Maker rewards, but you'll get monthly access to the game builds, and the best part of all, you get to join the developer Discord server!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/f1b6622bb6f78627a606d3f8d1d9933cf7e522cc.jpg[/img]
With this reward, you'll become an honourary of the dev team, and be given the chance to chat with me and the other developers and pitch your ideas!


So, if you're looking forward to playing Silver Daze as soon as possible, the best way you can help is to [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/login?then=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kickstarter.com%2Fprojects%2Fgem-games-ltd%2Fsilver-daze-a-coming-of-age-jrpg%2Fwatch]follow the Kickstarter page[/url] and support the game when the Kickstarter launches, to ensure we can keep the ball rolling all the way to release!

Thank you to everyone interested in this game! I hope to see you when the Kickstarter launches!

notes.title: END OF OCTOBER REPORT
notes.content:
Sawyer here!
This was a very busy month, and I wanted to show you guys what we've been keeping busy with over the course of the last couple weeks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/badf09f9475251a68216b313d3edaeeac11f1b4c.png[/img]

The star of the show for this month has been Black Zone! This is a terrifying zone inspired by many great works of horror, a rusty and oppressive locale with an unkillable Warden that chases you relentlessly like a villain from a slasher movie!

This zone actually began development all the way back in August, so I'm so glad to finally be done with it! I'm really happy with how it came out though, and I think the extra time I gave it was perfect since we were able to get the zone feature complete right in time for Halloween!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/62743ebed4c3313d7ed01a8775933eec05fc5013.png[/img]

Next up is a brand new type of dungeon, the ReCollection!
We finally got these implemented after planning them for months and months! In ReCollections, you're given a series of challenges to fulfill that you can wager points to accomplish! The more you wager, the more points you get back in return!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/effcc6f138e1704f6062a656198b3c329e7be199.png[/img]

I think finally having finished Black Zone as well as the ReCollections is gonna be a huge weight off my back! However, there is one last special thing we've been working on this last month that's also consumed a lot of my time...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/155b001bc67c0bb446a89dcea9fe03b6bba074b3.png[/img]

That's right, we're preparing a Kickstarter project!

The game is getting really big and we've had to do a lot of research and development for the programming side of things alongside the uptick in music and sprites. As a result, we've decided we're gonna opt for crowdfunding to help get the game finished!

There are gonna be lots of cool rewards, including the ability to make your own monsters and even some physical trading cards!

The campaign has not begun yet because I still have some preparations to make, but I will be making a proper announcement for it when we've got a date locked in.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gem-games-ltd/silver-daze-a-coming-of-age-jrpg]I also recommend following the campaign's pre-launch page so you'll be notified when it's ready![/url]

Other than that, this month featured a lot of testing and miscellenous handling of various animations and the usual things I have to make on a regular basis.
I hope to start doing monthly progress updates to help keep you guys posted on what we're working on!

Thanks a bunch for your support!
-Sawyer Friend

notes.title: Silver Daze Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
The demo for the upcoming indie RPG, Silver Daze, is now released! Silver Daze is a coming-of-age JRPG where you collect cards and battle monsters in a desolate frozen world. It is the third game created by Sawyer Friend, the creator of both Axial games, and the demo will be available on Steam as well as a playable browser build on Itch.io. The demo features the first chapters of the game up to the climactic encounter with Nyx, spanning roughly 90 minutes of gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/26fb5c378344f43e8c89ce373e77399af3c209e2.png[/img]

Silver Daze tells the story of the teenager Pinn as he finds his life slowly falling apart during the transition to adulthood, until the world suddenly becomes halted in stasis. Through the course of the demo, the player will guide Pinn through the frozen world as he reunites with his friends and defeats monsters in order to obtain stronger cards. The game features deep customizable turn-based combat and an enthralling character-centric narrative, with a surprising plot development at the end of the demo which will set up for bigger story beats in the full game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/64678c9de894657afcfeb574fd033600c825e780.png[/img]

The lead developer, Sawyer Friend, has been workshopping the concept of this game since 2018, but wanted to wait until the conclusion of the Axial story to begin developing the title proper. After a year of relative silence on new projects, Silver Daze was announced on June 24th. On social media, Sawyer Friend had the following to say: “It's so incredible seeing people playing my games again after a year or so since my last project! Thank you to everyone who's been playing Axial and Silver Daze!”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068836/a7d3f5ac1423d5039c67bf3d3d5f2f3e30e72304.png[/img]

Sawyer Friend’s dev team, Gem Games, is made up of a small team of hobbyists with a ton of enthusiasm for the project. Outside Sawyer himself, the primary contributors are Natan Maia, the lead programmer, and Bryan Graves, an additional composer alongside Sawyer. The team can be contacted via through their community Discord server using the following link: https://discord.gg/WGNhHP5GWr
